goal: Verify that the exact audit-derived relation-conditioned multi-layer interface executes correctly before any gradient decision.
procedure: Bind the exact compiled map by SHA-256, instantiate the real interface, exercise all directed relation types plus PAD and symmetric conflicts_with on deterministic synthetic hidden states, verify relation-specific candidate masks and normalized layer mixing, verify masked tokens receive no attention mass, verify outputs are finite and shape-correct, and hash the complete interface state before and after execution.
authority: May establish runtime correctness of the designed interface; may not authorize training, scale, heldout opening, promotion, or N0 completion.
validation: Magnolia whole-stage udocker execution completed; receipt SHA-256 779b19459fa8ab67bb1c3ed56b3e9cdb1b89b8382f145e1b3d7c4d98312b2b57.
failure_or_lesson: A new architecture should be qualified against its exact evidence-derived configuration before gradient work. Structural/runtime qualification can be compact and decision-changing without becoming a validator maze.
notes: Reusable seed: exact-state equality before/after qualification distinguishes implementation/runtime evidence from model-learning evidence.

goal: Design a fresh causal curriculum that specifically tests joint query-role semantics and relation direction rather than another endpoint classifier.
procedure: For each directed relation family, construct four-row factorial quads over source-vs-target query role and forward-vs-reversed edge direction while holding field text and relation type fixed. Require the target endpoint to flip under either causal factor. Keep train/dev/test wording, subjects, and attribute pools split-disjoint. Separately freeze parent-preservation lanes and forbid candidate-derived tolerance selection.
constraints: no previous failed training rows reused
no frozen or heldout rows reused
curriculum size is an operating budget not a capability ceiling
decision_criteria: both causal factors independently determine target
no global endpoint shortcut solves all four rows
preservation contract is fixed before candidate results
future training path must consume edge_relation_query_state from the real multi-layer interface
authority: May define and materialize experiment inputs and preservation policy; may not create optimizer, gradient, GPU candidate, or heldout result.
validation: Repository CI is responsible for deterministic curriculum compilation, factorial invariants, authorization freeze, and preservation-policy checks.
failure_or_lesson: When an earlier model collapses to one global endpoint preference, a stronger causal dataset should independently vary the semantic role requested by language and the graph edge direction. This makes the shortcut falsifiable instead of merely adding more examples.
notes: The curriculum is intentionally defined before training authorization so experiment design cannot adapt to a future candidate's behavior.
